metadata.title: Natural Products in Musanze
metadata.description: Imbaraga z'Igisura offers natural products in Musanze, Rwanda, near Musanze Bus Station: herbs, spices, natural oils, nuts, seeds and more. More than {years} years of experience. Call or WhatsApp us.

common.whatsappMessage: Hello {name}, I would like some information about your products.

hero.title: Natural products. Trusted for over {years} years.
hero.description: Explore our natural products and contact us directly by WhatsApp or phone. We are happy to help you find what you are looking for.

products.title: Explore our products
products.description: Discover our selection of natural products.
products.emptyTitle: Our products will be available here soon
products.emptyDescription: Product information, sizes and prices will be added here. In the meantime, contact us and we will gladly tell you what is available.

why.title: Why choose Imbaraga z'Igisura
why.experienceText: We have been offering natural products for more than {years} years.
why.naturalText: A selection of natural products, with clear information about each one.
why.personalText: You speak with us directly. We take the time to answer your questions about our products.
why.visitText: Come to our shop and speak with us in person.

order.title: How to get our products
order.step1Text: Look through our products here, or ask us what is available.
order.step2Text: Send us a WhatsApp message or call us. We will answer your questions and confirm your order.
order.step3Text: Collect your order at our shop in Musanze, or ask us whether it can be sent to you.
order.deliveryText: Depending on your location and the size of your order, products may be sent with buses travelling from Musanze to Kigali or other destinations. You collect the package yourself when it arrives.
order.deliveryNote: Please contact us first to check what is possible for your location. Sending options, timing and any costs are agreed directly with you.

info.title: Know what you are buying
info.description: Each product page will share the information available for that product, so you can choose with confidence.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Manage the products and categories shown on the website.
dashboard.howTo1: Open Products and choose an existing draft, or create a new product.
dashboard.howTo2: Write the name and information in Kinyarwanda and English (one language is enough for a draft).
dashboard.howTo3: Add real photos, then sizes and prices if they are confirmed.
dashboard.howTo4: Set the status to Published and save. The product appears on the website within a few minutes.

productForm.createIntro: Start with the name. You can add photos, sizes and prices on the next screen.
productForm.translationsHint: Fill in both languages when possible. A draft can be saved with one language; the website shows the other language until it is translated.
productForm.name: Name
productForm.shortDescriptionHelp: One or two sentences shown on product cards.
productForm.traditionalUseHelp: How it is commonly used. Write only information you are sure of.
productForm.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, e.g. {example}
productForm.statusHelp: Only Published products are visible on the website.
productForm.availabilityHelp: Leave as "Not shown" unless you keep it up to date.
productForm.deleteText: Deletes the product, its sizes and its photos permanently. To hide it temporarily, set the status to Draft or Archived instead.
productForm.deleteConfirm: Delete this product and all its photos permanently?

variants.title: Sizes and prices
variants.intro: One row per size. Leave the price empty if it is given on request; it is never shown as 0.
variants.label: Label (optional)
variants.empty: No sizes yet. The website shows "Price on request".

images.title: Photos
images.intro: Use real photos of the product only. JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF. Large phone photos are resized automatically before upload.
images.altHelp: Describes the photo for people who cannot see it.
